name: Cumbria Community Foundation Jeffrey Bond Memorial Fund
summary: Small grants to charitable and not-for-profit groups for nature conservation work in Cumbria, such as habitat creation and restoration, species conservation and hedge restoration, with priority for projects that involve volunteers.

applicant_types.quote: Who can apply? • charitable, not-for-profit groups

geography.quote: Grants to organisations to support nature conservation and the environment in Cumbria.

access.quote: All applications are now made through our online application portal

amount.quote: Grants will normally be up to £2,000 over one year.
